quests.instruction: We wear this instead of a swimsuit, when the ocean water feels icy cold. It is also worn before we go surfing, diving, or swimming in a chilly sea, but it is NOT your costume. What is it?
quests.question: Wetsuit
quests.hint: It covers your whole body snugly!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Wetsuit fits snugly over your whole body to keep you warm in cold water!
quests.funFact: A wetsuit traps a thin layer of water that your body warms up!

quests.instruction: We wear this on a freezing, windy day to keep our ears from hurting, but it is not your beanie. What is it?
quests.question: Earmuffs
quests.hint: They look a little like headphones.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Earmuffs cover just your ears with a padded band, keeping them warm!
quests.funFact: Earmuffs were invented by a boy who was tired of his cold ears.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the part we roll up when our arms get too warm? It is also the part that can be short, long, or completely missing on a vest, but it is NOT your hood!
quests.question: Sleeve
quests.hint: It is a part, not a whole piece of clothing!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Sleeve is the tube-shaped part of a top that covers your arm!
quests.funFact: A sleeve is the tube-shaped part of a shirt that covers your arm!

quests.instruction: We wear this when we jump and splash in puddles after a storm. It is also worn instead of sneakers on a wet, rainy, puddly day, but it is NOT your boots. What is it?
quests.question: Rain Boots
quests.hint: Hint: They keep your socks completely dry.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Rain Boots are made of waterproof rubber, keeping your feet dry in puddles!
quests.funFact: Rain boots are sometimes called 'wellies' in some parts of the world.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of a T-shirt, when even short sleeves feel too warm, but it is not your vest. What is it?
quests.question: Tank Top
quests.hint: It keeps your arms totally cool.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Tank Top has no sleeves at all, keeping your arms cool on hot days!
quests.funFact: Tank tops keep your arms cool on the very hottest days.

quests.instruction: We wear this that hugs our whole head snugly, with no brim at all. It is also worn instead of a cap, when we want our whole head warm, but it is NOT your hat. What is it?
quests.question: Beanie
quests.hint: Hint: It covers your ears completely.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Beanie is a snug knitted hat with no brim, keeping your whole head warm!
quests.funFact: A warm beanie is perfect for keeping your ears toasty in the cold.

quests.instruction: We wear this that every student at the same school wears together. It is also worn instead of picking our own clothes, for school or a team, but it is NOT your onesie. What is it?
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: Hint: It usually has the same colors as everyone else's.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Uniform is worn by everyone on the same team or school, all matching!
quests.funFact: Some schools ask every student to wear the very same uniform.

quests.instruction: We wear this over our clothes while we bake cookies or paint a picture. It is also worn in the kitchen, right before we start cooking dinner, but it is NOT your onesie. What is it?
quests.question: Apron
quests.hint: Hint: It catches spills and splatters before they hit your clothes.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Apron ties over your clothes to protect them from spills and splashes!
quests.funFact: Some aprons have a big pocket in the front, handy for holding a spoon.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is thin and light, but still blocks a gusty breeze. It is also worn on a breezy day when we do not want to feel chilly, but it is NOT your poncho. What is it?
quests.question: Windbreaker
quests.hint: Hint: It is much lighter than a winter coat.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Windbreaker is thin and light, yet still blocks a gusty breeze!
quests.funFact: Runners often wear windbreakers because they are so light and easy to move in.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of shoes, right after we wake up in the morning. It is NOT your shoes. What is it?
quests.question: Slippers
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are soft and worn indoors, not outside!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: Slippers are made soft and cozy just for wearing around the house!

quests.instruction: We wear this first, before we put on our shirt and pants. It is NOT your overalls. What is it?
quests.question: Underwear
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is worn first, under everything else!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: Underwear is the very first thing you put on when you get dressed!

quests.instruction: We wear this that keeps our chest and back warm but arms free. It is NOT your hoodie. What is it?
quests.question: Vest
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has no sleeves at all!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: A vest has no sleeves, so your arms stay completely free!

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that has pockets for keeping small things safe, not your shorts. What is it?
quests.question: Pants
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear a belt to help hold these up.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Pants keep your legs warm and protected when you play outside.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that can be short or reach down to our ankles, not your overalls. What is it?
quests.question: Skirt
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It swishes when you walk or twirl.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: Some skirts are pleated, which means they have neat folds all around.

quests.instruction: We wear this with soft, bouncy soles that cushion every step. It is NOT your tank top. What is it?
quests.question: Sneakers
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are made for running and jumping!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: Sneakers have soft, bouncy soles that make running more comfortable!

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this with our coat on the coldest days of the year, not your bow tie. What is it?
quests.question: Scarf
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It keeps icy wind off your neck.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: Some people wear light scarves in summer just for looking stylish.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of closed shoes when the weather is hot. It is also worn when we walk on warm sand near the ocean, but it is NOT your flip-flops. What is it?
quests.question: Sandals
quests.hint: Think about this: They have straps instead of covering your whole foot.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: Some sandals are made specially for walking in shallow water.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our hands when it is cold outside. It is also worn before we go outside to build a snowman, but it is NOT your bow tie. What is it?
quests.question: Gloves
quests.hint: They go on your hands!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Gloves give our fingers a warm hug in winter!

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this first, before we put a jacket on over it, not your sweatshirt. What is it?
quests.question: Shirt
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You tuck this into your pants sometimes.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: A clean shirt every day helps you feel fresh and comfy.

quests.instruction: We wear this to stay warm and cozy indoors. It is also worn on a cool autumn day before winter arrives, but it is NOT your tank top. What is it?
quests.question: Sweater
quests.hint: It is soft, warm, and often knitted!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Many sweaters are knitted from soft, warm yarn!

quests.instruction: We wear this over everything else when it is very cold outside. It is also worn to stay toasty warm on the coldest days of winter, but it is NOT your snowsuit. What is it?
quests.question: Coat
quests.hint: It is thicker and warmer than a jacket!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: A warm coat can keep you toasty even in freezing weather!

quests.instruction: We wear this backward sometimes just for fun. It is also worn with a soft, rounded top and no floppy edges, but it is NOT your sleeve. What is it?
quests.question: Cap
quests.hint: Think about this: Baseball players often wear these.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: Many sports teams have their own special caps with a logo.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our feet under our shoes. It is also worn before we put our shoes on in the morning, but it is NOT your sneakers. What is it?
quests.question: Socks
quests.hint: They go on your feet before your shoes!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Socks keep our feet warm and make shoes comfortable!

quests.instruction: We wear this with just one strap that fits between our big toe and the next. It is also worn instead of sandals with lots of straps, for easy beach days, but it is NOT your rain boots. What is it?
quests.question: Flip-Flops
quests.hint: Hint: You can slide these on in one second flat.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Flip-Flops have one simple strap and slide on fast for easy beach days!
quests.funFact: Flip-flops are one of the fastest shoes to slide on and off.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of a plain sweater, for extra warmth and fun. It is also worn when we want a warm top with a hood attached, but it is NOT your turtleneck. What is it?
quests.question: Hoodie
quests.hint: Think about this: It usually has a big front pocket.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: Many hoodies have a warm front pocket, perfect for cold hands.

quests.instruction: What do we call the fastener found on shoes for children who are still learning to tie a bow? It is not your waistband!
quests.question: Velcro
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is often used instead of shoelaces.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Velcro is a fuzzy fastener that sticks together with a satisfying rip!
quests.funFact: Many children's shoes use Velcro because it's easier than tying laces.

quests.instruction: What do we call the spot where we might keep a coin, a small toy, or a folded note? It is not your cuff!
quests.question: Pocket
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You slip your hand inside to warm your fingers.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Pocket is a small pouch sewn in for holding coins, toys, or notes!
quests.funFact: You can warm your hands by slipping them into a cozy pocket.

quests.instruction: We wear this with just one little pocket for the thumb. It is also worn on the very coldest days, warmer than regular gloves, but it is NOT your scarf. What is it?
quests.question: Mittens
quests.hint: Think about this: Only your thumb gets its own little space.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Only your thumb gets its own separate space in a mitten.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our legs on a hot summer day. It is also worn when we run and play outside in the heat, but it is NOT your overalls. What is it?
quests.question: Shorts
quests.hint: They cover your legs, but only a little bit!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Shorts keep your legs cool on hot summer days!

quests.instruction: What do we call the piece that runs in a neat row down the front of some shirts? It is not your sleeve!
quests.question: Button
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You do these up one at a time.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Button is a small piece that pushes through a hole to close your clothes!
quests.funFact: Doing up your own buttons is a great skill for getting dressed alone.
